title: Airlines and Relevant Authorities Safeguard Passenger information
what_it_is: Airlines and Relevant Authorities Safeguard Passenger information

sections.label: Airline cybersecurity protection measures
sections.summary: Airlines are assumed to be targets and must protect themselves, with CAAS working with Singapore carriers to strengthen cybersecurity capabilities and conduct joint exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Our operating assumption is that our airlines will be targets, and they must do their best to protect themselves against such threats, and have a robust plan to prevent, detect and recover should an attack succeed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS), as the cybersecurity lead for the aviation sector, works closely with Singapore carriers to strengthen their cybersecurity capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: CAAS also regularly shares cybersecurity-related information, including from the Cyber Security Agency, and best practices with them, and conducts joint cybersecurity exercises.

sections.label: Carrier monitoring and data compliance
sections.summary: Carriers monitor breaches, join aviation information-sharing bodies, comply with data protection laws, and SIA confirmed no unauthorised codes on its payment webpage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: They also closely monitor reports of breaches and collaborate with others on cybersecurity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: They are part of the Aviation Information Sharing and Analysis Centre, a non-profit organisation that fosters the sharing of information on physical and cyber threats to aviation and best practices on mitigation, and they also participate in the Cybersecurity Workgroup under the International Air Transport Association.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: With respect to the security of passenger data, Singapore carriers are also required to comply with the Personal Data Protection Act and the data protection regulations of other states which they fly to.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As a precaution, Singapore Airlines (SIA) has performed checks and confirmed that there are no unauthorised codes on its payment webpage.

sections.label: Cybersecurity Commissioner and aviation infrastructure
sections.summary: The Cybersecurity Commissioner appoints an Assistant Commissioner for the sector, and the Cybersecurity Act's impact on aviation critical information infrastructure will improve passenger and operational safety.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Cybersecurity Commissioner appoints an Assistant Commissioner who can then look at this sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The implications of the Cybersecurity Act on the critical information infrastructure within the aviation industry will have an impact and will improve passenger safety as well as the safety of the operations of the industry.
